generator_hash_domain.ruling: FD2 (Tasks Gate R6): the mission_v3_generator composite hash domain = top-level package functions scripts/+mission_v3/*.m (non-recursive); the tests/ subdirectory and the +audits/ audit assets are excluded
generator_hash_domain.rationale: test files are verification assets, not scientific generation logic; including them would freeze the generator identity on test additions and block T-017/T-018 test growth; +audits/ members produce evidence, not the generation chain

notes: T-018 integration + regression entry (FD1-FD6); suites are executed unmodified via run(); captured suite logs are echoed above; n_cases comes from each suite's own ALL PASS/DETECTED (n/n) summary and is null when not parseable. Zero-change snapshot (FD3): mission_v3.stack_identity collect Strict=true over the live tree (the test_stack_identity suite itself runs on tempdir fixtures). Determinism (FD2, tworun only): T-017 chain assembly style on fixture seed t018_regression_seed_01 (test fixture, not a frozen scientific value); levels realization.u_river_mps / scn fields / kf all fields / plan all fields; SHA-256 via the java MessageDigest byte path over a structured serialization in the family_expand truth_hash style
